answer: Trace each new address's funding thread back through the ledger. If several wallets share one ridge of common ancestry, such as the same payer funding them within a few blocks, that cluster splits a single reward share and casts a single vote. An attacker spinning up 500 sybils must then fund each from an independent, already-aged source, which costs real capital and weeks per identity; at the zenith of an attack the marginal fake earns almost nothing while its setup cost keeps rising.
